It is also classified by IARC as "probably carcinogenic to humans" (Group 2A).
Q3: Dimethylcarbamoyl chloride is a well-defined small molecule with a specific molecular formula and a substantial body of scientific literature, indicated by over 5,000 references, which is considerably above average for similar chemicals.
